io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous positive-edge reset; resets FSM to walk_left.

io.name: bump_left
io.description: Bump from left; switches direction to walk right when walking.

io.name: bump_right
io.description: Bump from right; switches direction to walk left when walking.

io.name: dig
io.description: Command to dig when walking on ground.

functional_summary.overview: Moore FSM modeling a Lemming that walks left/right, switches direction on bumps, falls when ground=0, digs when instructed while walking on ground, and splatters after falling more than 20 cycles then landing. Outputs are decoded from state (Moore).
rules: Reset (areset high, async) forces state to WALK_LEFT with fall counter cleared; outputs walk_left=1, others 0.

Walking states: if ground=0, transition to FALL (aaah=1) and start fall counter; else if dig=1, transition to DIG (digging=1); else if bump_left or bump_right (including both), switch walking direction.
Fall has precedence over dig, which has precedence over direction switching.
Falling: increment fall counter each cycle while ground=0. When ground=1, if fall counter > 20, transition to SPLAT (all outputs 0, absorbing); otherwise resume walking in the pre-fall direction.
Bumps while falling or digging are ignored; bumps in the same cycle ground disappears or reappears do not change walking direction.
Digging: continue digging while ground=1; when ground=0, transition to FALL (aaah=1) and start fall counter; resume original walking direction after landing (if not splattered).
Dig command while falling or when ground=0 is ignored.
Splat state is absorbing: all outputs remain 0 until reset.
Outputs are Moore-decoded from state: WALK_LEFT -> walk_left=1; WALK_RIGHT -> walk_right=1; FALL -> aaah=1; DIG -> digging=1; SPLAT -> all 0.
